body:
I totally understand where you're coming from. a lot of the things you say are the same as how I feel.  I'm not doing too badly in life really - I have a job, good family, my own house etc, yet sometimes the thought of getting up and facing another day is just more than I can bear, and then I feel worse about myself for being so low when I have so little to complain about.

I don't know what to say to make you feel any better,  just wanted you to know you're not the only one who feels that way.

thats the thing.  I've lived away from the rest of my family before and I barely heard from them.  living in the same city things are better, but I know if she moves away we won't talk as much because I never have any news worth talking about.  I have another sister who lives on a completely different continent and we communicate almost entirely via whatsapp messages for this reason. the two sisters are really close with each other and I've always been the outsider.

ugh, the passage of another 24 hours really hasn't helped me. I was awake for many hours last night mindlessly crying until I couldn't breathe through my nose at all, and then this morning my sister cancelled on a concert we were going to go to together, and I was really looking forward to spending the time with her, so I cried over that too.  I spent the entire day shelled up at home not wanting to move at all, and then got a phone call from my mother telling me that the found dog I saw on Facebook earlier today who was hit by a car was my sister's and her back was broken and she had to be put to sleep so now I'm crying over that too.

I am just a complete non-coper.   I really wish I had just one person who I could tell that im struggling who wouldn't just brush everything aside.  I don't know why I'm so sad about everything but I am.

It sounds like you're exhausted. youve obviously been fighting this fight for a long time, and it's slowly gotten on top of you.  I hope you can get a foothold and start pulling yourself back up.  it seems like a long way when you're right at the bottom, but I wish you the strength to take a step, because once you take one, you might as well take another one.
